title: 保育園・幼稚園の行事
subject_en: Crayon-textured children's illustrations of kindergarten events, each ONE scene or object centred in its cell, bright cheerful colours with waxy outlines. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 遠足・防災訓練・お遊戯会・いも掘りなど、保育園や幼稚園の行事を描いた12点です。おたよりや園内掲示に使えます。
items: children walking in a line with backpacks
children in safety hoods walking calmly
children in animal costumes on a stage
children running a race with a ribbon at the finish
children throwing balls at a basket pole
a child with a birthday crown and a cake
children and a teacher with a mallet and mortar
a small kindergarten bus with children waving
children playing in mud with buckets
a child holding a diploma tube
